fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has histologically or cytologically confirmed advanced or metastatic solid tumor

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have demonstrated documented prior clinical benefit, defined as CR or PR at any time during treatment, or SD lasting ≥6 months (Part 2 only)
